facts.business: PSP Projects Limited is a construction company specializing in end-to-end construction services including MEP and interior fit-outs, delivering turnkey solutions across industrial, institutional, government, and residential segments.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant accounting judgements including estimation of costs to complete, determining the stage of completion and timing of revenue recognition
Estimation of total revenue and total cost to complete contracts is inherently subjective, complex and requires significant management judgment
Forecast of contract revenue and/or contract cost may get subsequently changed due to change in prevailing circumstances, assumptions, contract variations or any other factor
